description: One case per toggle: the estate with proofMissingThresholdUnset on and nothing else. The known answer is F-PROOF-MISSING-THRESHOLD, the Finding of Check PROOF-MISSING-THRESHOLD, whose severity (Medium) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: proofMissingThresholdUnset, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.sh fixed, then infra/as-found.sh proofMissingThresholdUnset=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The Proof of delivery missing threshold is unset. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
